name: no-cohorts-month-end
about: The shape production sends until Q-AD34: no cohorts at all, on the last day of the month (0 days left).

output.headline: October 31, 2026 closed the month with 2 campaigns delivering 7 leads at $40.61 each on $284.25 spent.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet led the day: $184.50 spent, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks, 6 leads at $30.75 cost per lead, and a 1.5% click rate.
Dedicated night runs added 1 lead at a cost per lead of $99.75 on $99.75 spent, 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks, and a 1.1% click rate — notably higher cost per lead than the other campaign.
October 2026 is now closed with 0 days left; total Meta spend for the month came to $8,124.50.
No cohort data and no lead quality data are available for this period.
